questions.Q8.0: On one GPU platform, does QDF (released settings) still beat its paired SIGMA_I control in the 8 analysis cells of v4/v5/v7? (descriptive; cells are fixed in advance, not re-selected)
questions.Q8.1: When QDF also gets a validation-selected hyperparameter (meta learning rate) with a grid of the same size as the surrogate's, does the validated surrogate I + a*S0n still recover >= 80% of QDF_VAL's gain?
questions.Q8.2: Does the doubled-diagonal surrogate I + a*D0n, D0n = (S0n + Diag S0n)/2, with validated a beat the plain surrogate I + a*S0n?
questions.Q8.3: Does the budget-implied replay surrogate (released meta-SGD replayed on kappa*S0n, no forecaster in the loop) recover the QDF gain, (i) with kappa = tr(S0)/T and no validation (one run), (ii) with kappa validated over {0.5, 1, 2} * tr(S0)/T?

seeds: OPTION_FULL: 5 seeds for ETTh and iTransformer/ECL-96, 3 for ETTm/Weather (as before). OPTION_REDUCED: seeds 2021-2023 everywhere.

arms_per_seed.QDF_LR<m>: released QDF with meta_lr = m * released meta_lr; m in {1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1, 2, 4, 8} for TQNet (7, same size as the TQNet a grid) and {1/4, 1/2, 1, 2, 4} for iTransformer (5); m = 1 is the released QDF
arms_per_seed.QDF_VAL: lowest best validation MSE over QDF_LR<m>, ties to m = 1, then to the smaller m; test MSE never used
arms_per_seed.PLUGIN_A<a>: Sigma = I + a*S0n, a grid {0.01,0.03,0.1,0.25,0.5,1,2} (TQNet) / {0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3,1} (iTransformer); rerun on the v8 platform
arms_per_seed.PDIAG_A<a>: Sigma = I + a*D0n with the same a grid (new mode plugin_diag_abs in fixed_sigma_patch.py)
arms_per_seed.REPLAY_K<k>: Sigma = replay of the released meta-SGD (same meta_lr, steps, halving schedule, P0 = I, L = tril(P) + 1e-6 I) on the constant moment k * (tr S0/T) * S0n, k in {0.5, 1, 2} (new mode replay in fixed_sigma_patch.py, same code as paper/scripts/resim_meta.py)

quantities.R_X: mean g_X / mean g_QDF_VAL (primary) and / mean g_QDF_LR1 (secondary)

Q8.1.SURROGATE_MATCHES_TUNED_QDF: in >= k cells R_PLUGIN_VAL >= 0.8 and g_PLUGIN_VAL > 0 for >= min_pos seeds

Q8.2.DIAG_BETTER: in >= k cells mean D_diag > 0 and D_diag > 0 for >= min_pos seeds
Q8.2.DIAG_WORSE: in >= k cells mean D_diag < 0 and D_diag < 0 for >= min_pos seeds

Q8.3.REPLAY_RECOVERS: in >= k cells R_REPLAY_K1 >= 0.8 and g_REPLAY_K1 > 0 for >= min_pos seeds (same rule reported for REPLAY_VAL)

decision_rules.secondary: Wilcoxon signed-rank over cells of mean(g_PLUGIN_VAL - g_QDF_VAL); per-cell t-intervals; selected m and a; QDF_LR1 and SIGMA_I against the v4/v5/v7 values of the same cell (cross-platform, descriptive).

selection_and_failures: A run with non-zero return code, missing or non-finite test MSE, or no finite validation MSE is ineligible for selection and is reported. If every grid run of a seed fails, that seed has no value for that arm. A failed SIGMA_I removes the seed from the cell. Each failed run is retried once (run_v8.sh, --retry_failed); the later record replaces the earlier one, and both stay in runs_v8.jsonl. Divergence of QDF at large meta learning rates is an expected outcome, not an engineering failure.
R_undefined: if mean g_QDF_VAL <= 0 in a cell, R is undefined there and the cell counts as neither recovering nor failing for Q8.1 and Q8.3 except under the FAILS rules, where it counts as failing
